name: Portents of Uldum
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Greetings once again, adventurer!  Your discovery inside Uldaman has set the Explorers' League abuzz with excitement.  The League has been working to unlock the secrets of the miniature platinum discs you found.  Your fortuitous arrival here in the Hall allows me to share with you that we are quite possibly on to something!

Historian Karnik has uncovered some important clues as to the true origins of the Valley of the Watchers in the Tanaris desert.  He would like to speak with you as soon as possible!
narrative.objectives: Speak with Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers within Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I am glad you're maintaining your interest in exploration, adventurer!  With your natural talent and moxie, we could crack open secrets that we never thought were possible!

The Discs of Norgannon in Uldaman were a repository of vast information; you were only permitted to access the top layers, as it were, of the information stored there.  The Creators were rumored to have more repositories located throughout Azeroth.  This now brings us to Uldum...

chain.subtitle: 10 quests from level 47 to 50, 30,080 XP in all.

quests.name: The Platinum Discs
quests.objectiveText: Speak with stone watcher and learn what ancient lore it keeps.

quests.name: The Platinum Discs
quests.objectiveText: Take the miniature version of the Discs of Norgannon to the Explorers' League in Ironforge.

quests.name: The Platinum Discs
quests.objectiveText: Take your reward voucher to Dinita Stonemantle in the Vault of Ironforge.

quests.name: Portents of Uldum
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers within Ironforge.

quests.name: Seeing What Happens
quests.objectiveText: Bring the miniature platinum discs to the gates of Uldum in Tanaris and look for clues as to the connection between the two.

quests.name: The Stone Watcher
quests.objectiveText: Learn the purpose of the Stone Watcher of Norgannon, and then interact with the Uldum Pedestal in the Tanaris desert.

quests.name: Return to Thunder Bluff
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Return to Ironforge
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Historian Karnik in Ironforge.

quests.name: A Future Task
quests.objectiveText: Speak with High Explorer Magellas in Ironforge.

quests.name: A Future Task
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.
